question: The decades __________ are referred to as the period of steady population growth.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1921-1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The period from **1921-1951** is referred to as the era of steady population growth in India.

• During this period, India witnessed gradual changes in population dynamics owing to improved health conditions and a decline in mortality rates.

• The **1921 Census** marked the beginning of population stabilization after experiencing fluctuations in earlier decades due to famines and pandemics.

• The **1941 Census** indicated a continued rise in population despite challenges such as World War II.
